greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Uthando lukaThixo uYise, ubabalo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, kunye nokubambisana koMoya oyiNgcwele makube nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele inceba. Kristu, usivele inceba. Nkosi, usivele inceba.
psalm_response: Hayi ubumnandi bamazwi akho emlonyeni wam!
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona incwadi evulekileyo. Ayisiyo incwadi nje eqhelekileyo, kodwa ngumqulu omdala, osongeka ngendlela ethile, ohlala esandleni sikaThixo. KwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo namhlanje, uYohane uyalelwa ukuba awuthathe lo mqulu, awuginye. Uthi, 'Uya kuba mnandi emlonyeni wakho njengobusi, kodwa esiswini uya kuba muncu.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Ubusi kunye nomuncu. Le yimfihlelo yobomi bethu, akunjalo? Kukho izinto ezimnandi njengobusi—ukuhleka kukaBen xa wayethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, ukufudumala kwesandla sakhe esigxalabeni sikaBawo, ukuba naye ecaleni kwakho xa nijonga iinqwelo-moya kwisikhululo. Ezo zizinto ezimnandi, ezisishiya nencasa yobumnandi emoyeni wethu.

Kodwa ke, kukho loo 'muncu' awuthethayo uYohane. Muncu ngenxa yokuba ubomi abuhambi ngendlela esiyicwangcisileyo. Muncu ngenxa yokuba kukho izihlalo ezingenabani kwitafile yenu. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, lo muncu uyakwazi ukuba nzima kakhulu. Ngamanye amaxesha, ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela, kubangela ukuba intliziyo yakho ibe nzima ngendlela ongenakuyichaza. Kodwa nceda, mamela kakuhle: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu ungena etempileni. Ubona indawo ekwakufanele ukuba yeyomthandazo ijikwe yaba yindawo yokuthengisa. UYesu uyayicoca. Ufuna indlu kaYise ibe yindawo yoxolo. Ben wayeyiqonda le nto yokuba 'indlu' ingaphezu nje kweendonga. Wayeyiqonda indlu njengendawo apho uthando lwakhe lwaluhlala lukhona. Khumbula indlela awayefuna ngayo ukunika yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam? Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndikukholelwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndiwamkela njengokungathi ukhona kakade, kwaye ndizibophelela ngokupheleleyo kuwe. Ungaze uvumele ukuba ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakusikelela, akugcine, kwaye akunike uxolo oludlulayo kuko konke ukuqonda. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela umfana wethu uBen kunye nabo bonke abo basishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abo basentlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele, abanike amandla, kwaye abazalise ngethemba eliphilayo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuQala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndeva ilizwi livela ezulwini lithetha kum. Lathi: 'Hamba, uthathe umqulu ovulekileyo osezandleni zengelosi emi elwandle nasemhlabeni.' Ndiye kwingelosi, ndayicela ukuba indinike umqulu omncinci. Yathi kum, 'Wuthabathe, uwuginye. Uya kuba muncu esiswini sakho, kodwa emlonyeni wakho uya kuba mnandi njengobusi.' Ndiwuthabathile umqulu omncinci esandleni sengelosi, ndawuginya. Emlonyeni wam wawumnandi njengobusi, kodwa ndakuba ndiwutyile, isisu sam saba muncu. Emva koko kwathiwa kum, 'Umele uphinde uprofete malunga nezizwe ezininzi, iintlanga, iilwimi, kunye nookumkani.'

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Hayi ubumnandi bamazwi akho emlonyeni wam! Ndiyavuya ngendlela yemithetho yakho, njengokuba ndivuya ngobutyebi bonke. R. Hayi ubumnandi bamazwi akho emlonyeni wam! Imiyalelo yakho iluvuyo lwam; yiyo ecetywayo ngam. R. Hayi ubumnandi bamazwi akho emlonyeni wam! Umthetho womlomo wakho undixabise ngaphezu kwewaka leziqwenga zegolide nesilivere. R. Hayi ubumnandi bamazwi akho emlonyeni wam! Hayi ubumnandi bamazwi akho emlonyeni wam, omnandi ngaphezu kobusi! R. Hayi ubumnandi bamazwi akho emlonyeni wam! Imiyalelo yakho ililifa lam ngonaphakade; luvuyo lwentliziyo yam. R. Hayi ubumnandi bamazwi akho emlonyeni wam! Ndiyaphefumla ngomlomo ovulekileyo, ndinqwenela imiyalelo yakho. R. Hayi ubumnandi bamazwi akho emlonyeni wam!

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wangena etempileni waqalisa ukugxotha abo babethengisa, esithi kubo, 'Kubhaliwe kwathiwa, Indlu yam iya kuba yindlu yomthandazo, kodwa nina niyenze umhume wamasela.' Wayefundisa yonke imihla etempileni. Ababingeleli abaziintloko, ababhali, kunye neenkokheli zabantu, babefuna ukumbulala, kodwa abafumananga ndlela yakukwenza oko, ngenxa yokuba bonke abantu babexhonywe emamazwini akhe.

day: Friday of the Thirty-third Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
